provider.name: Cukka — Shopify Global Catalog Agent Data Layer

info.name: Cross-Store Cheapest In-Stock Variant Finder
info.description: Clusters identical products across Shopify Global Catalog & storefronts by UPID/SKU, filters out-of-stock variants, normalizes pricing, and returns the cheapest in-stock variant with direct cart link.

info.name: Product Normalization, Size Chart & Compatibility Enricher
info.description: Normalizes raw Shopify catalog items into standard taxonomy categories, EU/US/TR size conversion matrices, and compatibility tags. Metered via x402 'upto' based on LLM token usage.

info.name: Real-Time Restock Alert & 30d Price Delta Signal
info.description: Monitors Shopify variant stock state and price drops across merchants.

info.name: Vertical Niche Matcher (Cosmetic INCI / Spare Parts / Gift Matrix)
info.description: Deep technical filtering over Shopify Global Catalog for ingredient safety, part compatibility, or persona-based gift discovery.
